data.overview: Our dynamic Dispute Resolution practice handles cases in trial and appellate courts across Nigeria, as well as local and international arbitration proceedings under institutional rules including the ICC, UNCITRAL, and LCIA. We focus on achieving timely, efficient outcomes, resorting to litigation only when it cannot be avoided.

coreServices.title: Litigation
coreServices.description: Representing clients in trial and appellate courts across Nigeria, with a focus on timely and cost-effective outcomes.

coreServices.title: Arbitration
coreServices.description: Conducting domestic and international arbitrations under ICC, UNCITRAL, and LCIA rules, as well as ad-hoc references.

coreServices.title: Enforcement
coreServices.description: Enforcing arbitral awards and foreign judgments, including multi-jurisdictional enforcement proceedings.

approach.text: We provide top-tier legal advice designed to help clients avoid unnecessary cost where possible, and when litigation is unavoidable, we focus on achieving swift, effective resolution. Our access to an extensive base of resources means we can offer solutions, not just advice.
points: Extensive experience across trial, appellate, and arbitral proceedings
Fellows and Members of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, UK
Focus on efficient, commercially sound outcomes
